decision: The revised bounded probe design is peer-reviewable for freezing. This receipt does not authorize model execution; root must separately issue GO after freezing the reviewed hashes.
scope: Independent read-only review of the revised p20183 rank-5 phi7 SIMD numerator/lane probe for paired B1 and DM065 original-executable runs.
review_method: Used the existing Cloud-BAL Graphify graph as a navigation aid; verified conclusions directly against source, the pinned original executable, gate logic, and existing raw captures.

Reviewed the corrected earlier-PH watch and loop-header prepoint, the exact vector operand base calculation, per-operation opcode and lane capture, independent target-address reconstruction, arithmetic replay gate, and paired phi/KDM gates.
Compared the actual original executable SHA and relevant disassembly against the reviewed instruction PCs and opcodes.

binary_review.arithmetic_sequence: The fixed operation PCs and bytes match objdump of the pinned executable.
binary_review.operand_pointer_binding: Numerator operand slot 0 is loaded via pointer at rbx+0x280, slot 1 at rbx+0x200, slot 2 at rbx+0x2a0, and slot 3 via r13. The revised vector_operand_bases helper now matches those exact bases; it no longer uses the coefficient-prep pointer at rbx+0x290.
binary_review.read_watch_timing: Watching PH(k−1) arms the conditional loop-header breakpoint before target level k is processed under the source loop order. Candidate checks remain bounded to 500 vector headers; only a candidate whose prospective AL store range contains the exact target address enables the arithmetic stops.
binary_review.watch_pc_gate: The event records the actual post-access PC. The offline gate requires that PC to correspond to one of the mapped PH/PH-next vector loads, rejects PHB-load PCs, and checks PH/PHB storage ranges are disjoint.

raw_binding_review.details: The existing B1 and DM065 raw target captures each contain 15 owning phi entries. Entry seven has caller 0x13eb579 and the target PH/PH-next/PHB/PHB-next raw words used in the plan. Existing independent bridge evidence confirms phi-to-prep and prep-to-KDM target word/pointer matches. These are existing input bindings, not evidence of SIMD lane attribution.

gates_reviewed: phi7 caller, completed KDM count, bounds, hypsometric option, use_theta_m, raw LOGICAL and target words are checked in the probe and independently compared to the seventh paired phi entry by the gate.
Target AL and neighbor PH addresses are reconstructed independently from recorded bases and actual bounds; watch address, vector slot addresses, lane mapping, and selected store address are checked.
The ordered 12-instruction sequence verifies each exact opcode, selected XMM lane, float32 replay, final AL register result, and stored four-byte AL word.
Existing unchanged source/executable/runtime/input hashes, phase0 target KDM parity, and h00 history checks remain required by the runner.
limitations: No model execution or replay was performed during this design review.
The synthetic gate result was reported by the probe author; this reviewer inspected the updated fixture and gate but did not independently execute the test.
Review establishes probe design and static binding only; it does not establish runtime observation, scientific validity, or a model change.
reviewer_note: The initial v1 NO_GO receipt remains preserved at validation/numerator_design_review.json. No source, executable, probe, input, or model data were modified by this review.
